decisions.decision: Board agreed to check with Town Counsel on the validity of the Shady Point Special Permit (requested by Ms. Luck).

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Volunteer hours at the Senior Center were valued at $27,615.50 if paid $11.00 per hour.
budget_items.quote: this year we had 45 volunteers donate 2510.5 hours at the senior center. if they were paid at $11.00 per hour, it would amount to $27,615.50.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Attorney LaFountain reported Shady Point police detail amounts for 2016, 2017 and 2017 year to date; Mr. Spindt said Shady Point spends thousands annually on details and suggested the Town chip in.
budget_items.quote: attorney lafountain reported the following amounts: 2016: $16,474; 2017:$13,229 and $9,425 to date for this year.

budget_items.topic: Lake policing funding by lake associations
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Chief Marino said the Lake Shirley Association usually contributes money to lake policing because the Town does not have it in its budget.
budget_items.quote: usually the lake shirley association kicks in money too because we do not have it in our budget.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Attorney LaFountain said his clients would not object if the Board allocated additional funds for a Police boat on the lake during summer.
budget_items.quote: my clients would have no complaints if this board would allocate additonal funds for a police boat to be on the lake at all times during the summer.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Police Boat in the FY19 Capital Plan has been ordered.
budget_items.quote: the police boat that was part of the fy19 capital plan has been ordered.
